points.statement: Every program is indexed by its description embedding so that it can be retrieved in similar future situations.
points.quote: Each program is indexed by the embedding of its description, which can be retrieved in similar situations in the future.

points.statement: Action programs in an ever-growing skill library are reusable, interpretable, and generalizable to novel tasks.
points.quote: It can construct an ever-growing skill library of action programs that are reusable, interpretable, and generalizable to novel tasks.

points.statement: The approach avoids requiring model parameter access and explicit gradient-based training or finetuning.
points.quote: Our approach bypasses the need for model parameter access and explicit gradient-based training or finetuning.
